risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/scripts, not in the risk map). Union pid command-line shell over the B1-19b service: register accounts and pids, back-fill the confirmation, set active / retired, list; no delete. Every write asks for the super account and a TOTP code read without echo, and writes the same audit table through the service; each write generates and prints an idempotency key for retries. The CLI logic is an injected run(argv, deps); the entry loads the built service from apps/api/dist. Output never prints the code, passwords or credentials. Written by hand.
